# Nerd Gauge (NG Hip Hop Platform)

> Built From Bars. Raised By Beats. The official platform for Nerd Gauge — authentic music, community quotes, graffiti art, and lyric competitions from Eswatini.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://ng-hiphop.com): Hero, latest release with audio player, featured quote, graffiti showcase, competition banner
- [Music Library](https://ng-hiphop.com/library): Full discography of active releases with inline streaming
- [Best Lyrics Competition](https://ng-hiphop.com/game/best-lyrics): Active lyric competition, prizes, winners, and submission portal
- [Submission Status](https://ng-hiphop.com/submissions/status): Check the review status of a competition submission
- [Terms of Service](https://ng-hiphop.com/terms): Platform terms and conditions
- [Privacy Policy](https://ng-hiphop.com/privacy): Data handling and consent policy

## Content by Topic

### Music
- [Music Library](/library): Stream all active releases, from classics to latest drops
- Latest release is featured on the homepage with direct streaming and distribution links (Spotify, Apple Music)

### Community
- Featured community quotes on the homepage (moderated before display)
- Graffiti/fan-art showcase on the homepage (moderated before display)
- Lyric competition with public submission, moderation queue, and winner announcements at [Best Lyrics](/game/best-lyrics)

### Legal
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Acceptance, IP, user content, disclaimer
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): Data collection, consent, retention
